name: pocket-shell
description: Pocket Shell for Nintendo 3DS, touch navigation and embedded desktop interfaces

scripts.setup: bun install --frozen-lockfile && git submodule update --init && bun install --cwd vendor/pocketjs --frozen-lockfile && bun scripts/setup.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun vendor/pocketjs/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && bun run --cwd shells/3ds typecheck && bun run --cwd shells/desktop typecheck && bun run --cwd shells/touch typecheck
scripts.test: bun test ./scripts && bun run test:link && bun run test:runtime && bun run --cwd shells/3ds test && bun run --cwd shells/desktop test && bun run --cwd shells/desktop test:sim && bun run --cwd shells/desktop test:wrap && bun run --cwd shells/desktop test:text && bun run --cwd shells/touch test
scripts.check: bun run check:assets && bun run check:schemas && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.check:devices: bun devices/3ds/tools/contracts.ts --check && bun devices/3ds/tools/stage-art.ts --check && bun run test:devices
